description.content: This operation lists or finds Product entities

query.description: A reference to a product spec by id
A reference to a product offering by id
A reference to the externalId provided in the order
A Geographic Address identifier which is associated to the product
A site identifier which is associated to the product

This criteria allows to retrieve all Product records with a Product Relationship to a specified Product.
E.g. All Products related to Product with ID 5
The Billing Account associated with the Product.
Identifies Product Order associated with the Product
Less than the date that is the initial install date for the Product
Greater than the date that is the initial install date for the Product
Less than date that the last change affecting this Product was completed
Greater than the date that the last change affecting this Product was completed
The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the a Buyer. MUST be specified in the request only when the requester represents more than one Buyer.
The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the Seller. MUST be specified in the request only when responding entity  represents more than one Seller.
Requested index for start of item to be provided in response requested by client. Note that the index starts with "0".
Requested number of items to be provided in response requested by client

response.name: OK. (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7231#section-6.3.1)

header.description: Used to indicate that result page was throttled to maximum possible size  and there are additional results that can be fetched
The total number of matching items. E.g. if there are 50 matching items in total, but the request has offset=10 and limit=10, then the X-Total-Count is 50.
The number of items included in the response

description.content:
**This file forms part of Mplify 116.1**

This API implements Business Requirements described in MEF 81 and MEF 81.0.1

It allows the Buyer to retrieve the information about existing Product
instances from Seller's Product Inventory.

List of supported use cases:

- Retrieve Product List

- Retrieve Product by Identifier
